description: Mostly an early-opening pattern with me (first player) to move: I hold the bottom of column 2 (often an X-O-X stack there), the opponent holds the bottom of the centre columns 3/4 (strongest just after they play there), I have no stone low in columns 3-4, and columns 0-1 are empty. If I took the centre bottom it does not fire; right-side mirror images do not fire. About half of firing is mid-game and unexplained.
effect: Small: when strongly active it shifts about 0.05-0.10 probability between the centre columns 3/4 and column 5 (direction varies by position); otherwise none measurable.
notes: 5 score calls; best F1 0.180 (P 0.16, R 0.21, AUROC 0.68), simulation share 0.06. Cell-weight rules on bottom cells of cols 2-4, ply parity and left-column emptiness capture the opening firing (minimal pairs agree: base 2,2 fires, base 3,x never; left-side stacks fire, right mirrors do not), but mid-game firing has no pattern I found. Synthesis peaks at 7.73 (dev max 8.07). Possibly a mixture or near-random direction.
